purpose: Locate the present moment immediately after an action ends.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I have just arrived at the station.
I have just boiled the water, so we can have a drink right away.
Locate a just-finished action or describe subjective recency
たばかり · still recent to the speaker
restrictions: Focuses on the action’s just-completed stage.
mistake: For broader subjective recency, たばかり may be more appropriate.

segments.role: Locate the present moment immediately after an action ends. た-form + ところ.

examples.translation: I have just arrived at the station.
